mentions.name: Monitor Monkey
mentions.description: Linux server monitoring tool aiming to be the easiest and nicest way to monitor Linux servers. It is implementing zero-config custom alerting: users write a JSON file (e.g. event_name, interval, data) to a home directory to define alerts, with no server-side configuration required, making it suitable for big deployments.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on Monitor Monkey[1]

It's attempting to be the easiest and nicest way to monitor Linux servers. I'm currently implementing 0 config custom alerting. All you will have to do is write a file to a home directory with some json in it e.g event_name:blah,interval:1m,data=10 - no server side config at all!

So should be quite suitable for big deployments :)
